title: Checkout total does not match cart total
goal: Complete a checkout with the correct cart total
reproSteps: Add any product to the cart
Compare the checkout total with the cart total

logs: SAMPLE DEMO DATA: seeded finding for judging. Live runs capture real screenshots and traces.

suspectedCause: Shipping fee is added twice when a coupon is present in the sample scenario.
suggestedFix: Compute the order total once in the cart service and reuse it at checkout instead of recomputing with fees.
regressionCheck: Re-run checkout with a coupon and assert cart total equals checkout total.
